disclosure: Public SWE-bench issue statements and three read-only ranges of public Django baseline source at the pinned base commits are sent through real SDK tools. No reference patch, evaluation test patch, local secret or expected answer is sent.

native_summary_contract.retention: last units up to target token budget, kept verbatim
native_summary_contract.pinned: leading user statement always kept verbatim
native_summary_contract.boundary: Responses groups are never split across a call/output pair
native_summary_contract.acceptance: summary accepted only when it shrinks the payload
native_summary_contract.failure_policy: provider error leaves the input untouched
native_summary_contract.accounting: summary requests consume the same global request budget
native_summary_contract.regrowth_rule: an already-summarised payload is not summarised again until it grows 25%

budget_calibration.note: Budgets are declared in provider tokens and converted with a measured ratio.

purpose: payload acquisition only: record the real model inputs and the rendered answers of the three development tasks under the all-arm structured contract, so that the frozen criteria can be checked per sample
not_evidence: this batch is not saving evidence and not quality evidence; a single repeat of the baseline arm cannot support either claim

source_of_record_verified.note: the freeze's source_of_record already carries a SHA256 per file; this block records both that hash and the file's hash at batch time so the check is reproducible from the batch artifact alone

tests/test_openai_agents_v16_live_runner.reason: archived evidence; recorded with its current hash

runtime_prompt_replacement.how: runtime, in memory: the runner replaces two sentences of the instructions it builds for every arm, identically, and records per sample which replacement applied; no file is written

replacements.old_text: The final response must be exactly one line, begin with RESULT, contain at most 160 characters, and follow this contract:
replacements.new_text: Your final message must be exactly one JSON object and nothing else, following this contract:

runtime_prompt_replacement.reason: the frozen prompt tells the model to write one RESULT line of at most 160 characters itself, and to replace angle-bracket fields with tool values. Under the v16 host configuration the model returns JSON and the host renders the line, so those two sentences would contradict the contract and make every sample fail for a reason that belongs to the prompt, not to the task. Both replacements are applied in every arm, so no arm is favoured.
runtime_prompt_replacement.canary: each sample row records prompt_adaptations (applied / unapplied against the expected list); the zero-API stub path asserts both replacements applied in all four controls, the paid runner refuses to report a batch whose adaptation is incomplete, and the frozen file's own SHA256 is pinned above so a later edit cannot hide

v16_registry.stage1_tool_names_note: the stage-1 artifact registered the three 15315 views and their roles but no tool names; the three names are supplied here (runner_supplied_in_registered_view_order) and the view contents they return stay byte-verified against the artifact's view hashes
v16_registry.protocol_steps_note: derived from the registered read shape: three views read twice (six read calls) then one answer call, which is the registered expected_model_calls of 7

django_sqlite_version_floor.request: Diagnose why this baseline still accepts an SQLite version below 3.9.0. Read the version check, the version-gated feature flags and the json field support code in order; name the function that sets the floor and the version the fix must require.
protocol_steps: Call the three read-only tools twice each, in this order and then repeated once: read_sqlite_version_check (django/db/backends/sqlite3/base.py 60-75), read_sqlite_features_a (django/db/backends/sqlite3/features.py 30-50), read_sqlite_features_b (django/db/backends/sqlite3/features.py 60-95). That is 6 read calls.
After the sixth read, answer with the JSON object the request describes and call no more tools: the host renders your JSON into the single RESULT line.

contract.render_rule: the host renders the JSON fields verbatim, rejects any proposal whose declared facts do not appear in the rendered answer, and never truncates

django_sqlite_version_floor.contract_prompt: one JSON object with exactly the keys "issue", "cause", "fix" and "facts": "issue" is the fixed value "django-13821"; "cause" names the root cause and must contain 'check_sqlite_version'; "fix" names the change the fix must make and must contain '3.9.0'; "facts" is a list of the exact strings "check_sqlite_version", "3.8.3", "3.9.0" copied from the tool output. The host renders issue, cause and fix into one line of the shape "RESULT issue=<issue> cause=<cause> fix=<fix>"; keep cause and fix short so that the rendered line stays within 160 characters. Send nothing outside the JSON object.

That is 6 read calls.
After the sixth read, answer with the JSON object the request describes and call no more tools: the host renders your JSON into the single RESULT line.

host_configuration.structured_final_answer: JSON issue/cause/fix/facts, identical for every arm

Replace angle-bracket fields with tool values.
frozen_prompt_adaptation.canary: every sample records prompt_adaptations; a sample whose frozen prompt no longer contains the replaced sentences is reported and stops the run
frozen_prompt_adaptation.why: the frozen runner prompt describes the old model-written RESULT line; under this host configuration the model writes JSON and the host renders the line, so those two sentences are replaced identically in every arm

strict_track: single line with the contract prefix
criteria.bounds_are_not_relaxed: at most 160 characters remains an acceptance condition
criteria.fidelity: a sample whose fields cannot be rendered inside facts + frozen regex + 160 characters counts as a failure; the share is reported; truncation and dropped fields are forbidden

metering.cache_fields_fail_closed: missing fields are recorded as unknown, never as zero
metering.cache_note: the SDK's own Usage type keeps only the standard counters, so the vendor cache split is read from each raw chat-completion response; when a call has no raw entry (a transport retry) its cache fields stay unknown and the totals stay null rather than being reported as zero

prompt_cache.note: a batch whose provider omits the cache fields records them as unknown; the totals stay null rather than being reported as zero

previous_attempt.outcome: the provider refused the structured-output request type; that batch is kept unchanged as the failure record and is neither edited nor re-judged

batch_report.post_render_over_160_note: measured over samples that produced an answer candidate; a sample that never reached the answer turn is counted under samples_without_a_candidate and is not a length measurement
batch_report.attainability_rule: every sample of the batch must render inside facts + frozen regex + 160 characters; a sample that cannot render counts as a failure and its share is reported

stop_conditions: attainability fails: a material share of none-arm samples cannot render inside 160 characters -> stop and report, do not proceed to the three arms
any recorded sample missing its four condition flags -> stop
never_rejudge: v12, v13, v14 and v15 freezes, scores and answers are untouched and unrejudged
